title: test(spec): shared test titles state each cited decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 12)
body:
Part of #20749
Clause-②: no

Stage 12 of this card, and the third area of class (e): the test strings shipped under `packages/spec/src`, as ruled in `5902360492` on #20513. This stage takes the whole `shared/` directory. Its 85 test-title and test-string literals carried 95 tracker ids: 92 cite 49 records, and 3 are a `#0000` placeholder that cites none. Each id now either states what its record decided, in words (form D), or is dropped where the title already says it. Text only: no assertion, identifier, test count or code comment changes.

## Census at the base (`72b6333cd8`, the claim's base)

Instrument: stage 10's `census10.cjs` (md5 `9d08602ab972b4b8643c90d64d40fa41`) and stage 9's `census.cjs` (md5 `6e42a45a926d375013c32d62f16a296e`), both byte-identical to the copies stages 10 and 11 used. A literal counts as a test title when its folded message is argument 0 of a `describe` / `it` / `test` call, `.each` / `.skip` / `.only` chains included. Everything else is an "other" string.

Both instruments read **1594 messages / 1701 ids in 369 files at the base**, which is stage 11's reading at its head exactly. `shared/` reads 85 / 95, also stage 11's figure.

- **Controls.** Lit, a title: `shared/duration.test.ts:45` reads one message with #18122. Lit, an `expect` message: `shared/retry-policy.test.ts:113` reads one message. Dark: the comment at `shared/alias-integrity.test.ts:519` ("#5593 migrated the last of them") reads 0; the file's messages sit at `:516`, `:770` and onwards. Planted in a scratch copy: an id added to a title reads 1 / 1, and an id in an added comment reads 0.
- **A wider pattern** (any `#` plus digits) reads 87 / 97 under `shared/` at the base. The two extra hits are `(#1)` placeholders in two fixtures of `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` (`:378`, `:380`, the "accepts the two legal shapes" case). They fall outside the gate's 3-to-5-digit pattern and the claim's surface, and are untouched. At the head the wider pattern reads only those two, and the gate pattern reads 0 / 0.
- **At the head:** 1509 messages / 1606 ids in 348 files. `shared/` reads 0 / 0. Nothing else moved.

## How the area was chosen

Stage 10's rule: rank whole first-level directories by ids, and take the busiest one within about 10% of the ~100-id bound. The four busiest each exceed the bound alone: `data/` (501), `ui/` (415), `api/` (201) and `system/` (165). The files directly in `src/` (120) are 20% over. `shared/` (95) is the busiest whole directory within the bound, and its census reads exactly stage 11's 95, so the rule needed no second pass.

**Named for the next stages:** `data/` (about five stages, by subdirectory or file group; `data/driver/` alone is 52), `ui/` (about four), `api/` (two), `system/` (two), the files directly in `src/` (one, 120), `contracts/` with `conversions/` (one, 108), and `security/`, `ai/`, `identity/`, `integration/`, `migrations/`, `marketplace/`, `meta-spelling/` and `studio/` together (one, 96).

## What each id became

22 ids now state a decision in words, one per literal. 73 are dropped: 67 where the title already says what a live record decided, 3 dead numbers whose decisions were read from what landed, and the 3 `#0000` placeholders. Every cited record was read with its comments through REST. 46 answer 200. Three answer 404, and their decisions were read from their landing commits.

Each title already states the pinned decision. |

The two `retired-key.test.ts` constants are both input and expectation, so the byte-for-byte assertions move with them. It is the same reasoning by which #17109's patch round took the made-up `(ADR-0000)` out of these fixtures: a made-up number squats on a real one. |

## Readers

- **Test-name filters:** none. A tracked-tree search for `-t` and `--testNamePattern` finds only `packages/qa/dogfood/README.md:142` (`-t "owner-scoped"`), which is unrelated.
- **Snapshots:** none. `shared/` has no `__snapshots__`, and no `.snap` file is tracked under `packages/spec`.
- **Gates that read a touched file:**
  - `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` keeps a witnessed ledger entry for `retired-key.test.ts` (`witness: /was removed in @objectstack\/spec 99/`, `covers: 4`). The rewritten constants still carry that sentence. `check:future-spec-major` was derived for this diff and exits 0, "every witness still matching".
  - `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json` lists `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts`, so that file runs in the `repo` project. It was run there at the base and at the head.
- **Titles by substring:** every old literal, plus a window around each id (221 needles), was searched across the tracked tree outside its own file. No gate, doc, filter or script reads one. The 21 needle hits land on 8 lines:
  - Sibling titles in other lanes' files: `packages/cli/test/format-zod-union.test.ts:301` (`[#5389] formatZodErrors …`) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.unrecognised-meta-type.test.ts:171` (`[#10485] \`theme\` …`).
  - A later stage's row in this package: `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.test.ts:97`, an `it.each` row name with "retired at #3278".
  - A self-test fixture in `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs:767-768` that copies the two `retired-key.test.ts` constants with `(#0000)`. It is its own text and does not read the file.
  - Code comments: the `strict-object.ts:71` docblock example and `suggestions.zod.ts:319`.
  - A self-test fixture with a different string in `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs:2507`.

## Text-only proof

Stage 10's scratch tool (`textonly10.cjs`, md5 `d5e4801dbb4329ab1984da91e92fc47c`) compares base and head file by file on three legs:
1. **Skeleton:** the full AST, with string pieces masked. It must be identical.
2. **Comments:** every comment, byte-equal.
3. **Strings:** each string leaf that changed must sit in a test-call title position, or on one of the 12 declared lines. Each changed leaf must carry a tracker id before and no `#` plus digits after. The declared lines are:
   - the synthetic `history` strings at `alias-integrity.test.ts:917`, `:939`, `:952` and `strict-object.test.ts:16`, `:196`;
   - the `expect` messages at `alias-integrity.test.ts:1100` and `retry-policy.test.ts:113`;
   - the fixture constants at `retired-key.test.ts:26`, `:28` and the planted source at `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts:342`;
   - the fixture names at `union-branch-policy.parity.test.ts:164`, `:169`, which reach `it` titles through a template.

- **Result:** 21 of 21 files SAME, 85 changed (73 title, 12 declared), on all three legs.
- **Diff hunks:** exactly the 85 planned lines, with every file keeping its line count.
- **Controls (10 of 10 as predicted, on scratch copies, each anchor hit once):** identifier rename DIFF; numeric literal DIFF; comment edit COMMENT DIFF; a non-title string with an id VIOLATION; a rewritten title given a new id VIOLATION; a title that was id-free at base edited VIOLATION; one title reverted to base SAME; a declared string keeping an id VIOLATION; an undeclared `expect` message changed VIOLATION; a title re-split into a `+` chain DIFF.

**Test counts:** the 21 files were run at the base (in a separate base worktree) and at the head, 20 in the `local` project and one in `repo`. Both sides read 567 / 567 passed, with the same count and status sequence per file in 21 of 21. 450 full test names change, and each equals the base name with the planned replacements applied.

## Changeset: `skip-changeset`

Measured, not assumed:
- `npm pack --dry-run` of `@objectstack/spec` lists 2068 files under `files[]`. 0 of the 21 touched files are in it, and 0 `*.test.ts` at all. The control `src/shared/expression.zod.ts` is in it.
- In `dist/`, four new phrases read in 0 files. Of three old ones, two read in 0, and the third reads only in `shared/index.d.ts` / `.d.mts`, from the `strict-object.ts` docblock comment, not from a test. The control `Unrecognized key(s) on` reads in 42.

So this PR publishes nothing, and no changeset is added.

## Verification (at `fd8fd92d13`)

- `pnpm turbo run build` over all packages: 71 / 71.
- `@objectstack/spec`:
  - `vitest run --project local`: 613 files, 18215 passed, 1 todo.
  - `typecheck` exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck`. Its program holds all 21 touched files, counted with `tsc --listFilesOnly`.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 80 families, and all 80 exit 0. That is stage 11's 79 plus `check:future-spec-major`. `--ran` reconciles: 80 derived, 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - Five roster families whose rosters sit under a touched directory were also run, and each exits 0: `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- **ESLint, a proven narrowing:** `--no-inline-config` over the 21 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. The population comes from ESLint's own config: 21 configured, 0 ignored. No `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so no untouched file's verdict can move.
- `check-governed-merges --test`: NOT governed, 170 changed lines.

## Acceptance notes

- **Code comments still carry ids** in these 21 files and in the `shared/` sources. One of them ships: the `strict-object.ts:71` docblock example quotes the old widget `history` with `#4001`, and it is emitted into `dist/shared/index.d.ts`. Comments are not this card's share and are untouched here.
- **Sibling titles in other packages** repeat two rewritten titles' ids (`cli`'s `format-zod-union.test.ts:301`, `metadata-protocol`'s `protocol.unrecognised-meta-type.test.ts:171`). Each is its own lane's test-string stage. `spec`'s `ai/knowledge-source.test.ts:97` is this card's later small-directories stage.
- **`scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs:767-768`** keeps its own self-test copy of the two fixture constants with `(#0000)`. It is a non-test file outside this claim's surface, and it reads nothing from `retired-key.test.ts`.
- **`origin/main` moved** seven commits past the base before this PR opened (#21737, #21741, #21739, #21744, #21740, #21746, #21749). One touches `packages/spec` (`api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`); none touches a file in this diff, so nothing was merged.
